system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

In place of an attack granted by the Attack Action, you can spend 1 Superiority Die releasing a powerful echoing force of ghostly chakra that rattles the spirit. All creatures of your choice within a 30-foot cone originating from you must make a Charisma saving throw vs your Ninjutsu (or Genjutsu) Save DC. On a failed save, affected creatures gains 2 ranks of Dazzled.
